# Divine Flow Collective

> Divine Flow Collective is the Lake George, NY wellness and events practice of Danielle Donnelly — a certified Health & Wellness Coach (SUNY Adirondack) and 200-hour trained yoga teacher. Services are by appointment and brought to the client (homes, rentals, wedding venues, lakeside settings) across the Lake George area.

## Contact
- Phone / text: (518) 480-7102
- Email: divineflowcollective@gmail.com
- Website: https://divineflow.io/
- Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/Divine_Flow
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@divineflow04 (@divineflow04)

## Services and prices
- Private Group Yoga — $250 per session; mats provided for up to 10 guests. For bachelorettes, birthdays, family gatherings, retreats, and private groups.
- Event Planning — $100/hour. Full planning support for parties, weddings, and gatherings.
- Event Coordinator for Parties & Weddings (day-of coordination) — $1,500 flat rate for a full day.
- Wellness Services — from $50. Therapy-ball rolling, guided meditation, breathwork, and personal wellness plans.
- Oracle Readings — $20. Intuitive card readings, popular as an add-on for girls' weekends, bachelorettes, and retreats.

## Service area
Lake George, Glens Falls, Queensbury, Bolton Landing, Warrensburg, and the surrounding southern Adirondack / Lake George area, New York.

## Notes
- All services are by appointment only; there is no walk-in studio — Danielle travels to the client.
- Booking is by phone, text, or email.
